title: pb_unwrap
description: `pb_unwrap` decodes a complete Protocol Buffers sub-message from a list of byte-valued floats (0–255), emitting each decoded field from its left outlet and an `ok <nfields>` or `error <reason>` status from its right outlet. Use it for the raw payload of a wire-type-2 length-delimited field, without its length prefix; it wraps the `raw` method of `pb_decode`.
